partitions.label: 3D forecast forest and repair controls

partitions.label: Recurrent forest depth and width
partitions.scope: Capped deterministic cohorts, separate from the full-fold forest. Variant IDs identify root count, unroll depth and training step where recorded.

partitions.label: Analogical forecasting with a fitted blend
partitions.scope: Full folds. Standalone analogue scores. Validation selected blend weight zero for every analogue arm, so blended forecasts reproduced the frozen model.

partitions.label: Directed graph correspondence and search
partitions.scope: Triangle/day-capped observations. Four roots and 24 verifications for the two matched search arms.

partitions.label: GraphCG-R concept editor
partitions.scope: Contrastive intervention objective. Frozen forecast head and two training seeds. The objective does not denote forecast error.

partitions.label: Continuous GFlowNet and unconditional Gaussian
partitions.scope: Prescribed conditional terminal density. Target-to-model KL at sampled real FX contexts, with a shared unconditional Gaussian baseline.

partitions.label: Edited path GFlowNet
partitions.scope: FX-conditioned target components on retained teacher paths. Numerical comparisons concern terminal sampling, including edited and unedited states.

partitions.label: Rough forest generation
partitions.scope: One 377-context validation subset. Flow matching and DDPM model teacher trajectory residuals across matched seeds.
partitions.metric: Energy score and terminal forecast error

partitions.label: Rough forest repair proposals
partitions.scope: Same 377-context validation task per arm. The direct verifier is a distinct cheaper comparison.
partitions.metric: Margin MAE · log bps and accepted proposal fraction
